learnings.question: Which 19th-century psychologist demonstrated that people forget about 80% of newly learned information within just 24 hours unless they actively work to recall it?
options: William James
B.F. Skinner
Ivan Pavlov
Hermann Ebbinghaus
learnings.learning: Hermann Ebbinghaus showed in the 1880s that people forget roughly 80% of what they learn within 24 hours unless they actively force themselves to recall it, which is the basis for spaced repetition beating simple re-reading.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In a hadith recorded in Sahih Muslim, which three things continue to benefit a person even after they die?
options: Wealth, family, and good health
Daily prayer, fasting, and pilgrimage
Repentance, patience, and gratitude
Ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, and a righteous child who prays for them
learnings.learning: A hadith in Sahih Muslim (1631) states that when a person dies, all their deeds end except three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for them.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which artifact visually tracks a sprint's remaining work and helps a team see whether it's on schedule?
options: Burndown Chart
Sprint Backlog
Kanban Board
Product Backlog
learnings.learning: The Burndown Chart is the Scrum artifact that visualizes a sprint's progress, showing remaining work and whether the team is tracking to schedule.

learnings.question: What is the main purpose of breaking a project into small, iterative cycles called Sprints, as done in the Scrum framework?
options: To increase the overall length of the project
To allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments
To reduce the number of team members needed
To eliminate the need for a Product Owner
learnings.learning: Scrum breaks work into iterative Sprints specifically to allow more flexibility and quicker adjustments, rather than to shorten teams or extend timelines.

learnings.question: In an Islamic framework of life's purpose, which three roles are humans described as being called to fulfill?
options: Seeking wealth, gaining knowledge, and building a family legacy
Worshiping Allah, serving as stewards (khalifah) of the Earth, and preparing for the Hereafter through accountability
Achieving success, helping others, and finding happiness
Performing rituals, avoiding sin, and seeking forgiveness
learnings.learning: Life's purpose in this Islamic framework centers on three roles: worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah (steward) of the Earth, and living as a test of faith and conduct through accountability.

learnings.question: What Arabic term, used in the Quran, refers to humanity's role as a steward or caretaker of the Earth?
options: Khalifah
Taqwa
Shura
Ummah
learnings.learning: Khalifah is the Quranic term for humanity's role as steward or caretaker of the Earth, carrying responsibility for preserving faith and unity within the community.

learnings.question: The Quran verse describing 'an atom's weight of good' and 'an atom's weight of evil' each being seen by their doer illustrates which principle?
options: That only major sins are ever recorded
That good deeds automatically cancel out bad deeds
That intentions matter more than actions
That every deed, no matter how small, is accounted for and rewarded or punished
learnings.learning: Quran 99:7-8 teaches that every deed, however small ('an atom's weight'), is accounted for by Allah, reinforcing that no good effort is wasted.

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state is a very light sleep mode meant for short idle periods, letting the link wake up quickly to resume activity?
options: L2
L0
L0s
learnings.learning: L0s is PCIe's lightest power-saving state, designed for very short idle periods so the link can wake almost instantly, unlike the deeper L1 substates or L2.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: As a PCIe device moves into deeper power-saving states such as L1.1, L1.2, and L2, what is the general tradeoff involved?
options: Greater energy savings in exchange for a longer wake-up (resume) time
Faster wake-up time but higher energy use
Increased data transfer speed but reduced reliability
Lower manufacturing cost but reduced device lifespan
learnings.learning: PCIe's deeper power states (L1.1, L1.2, L2) power down more components for greater energy savings, at the cost of a longer time to wake back up.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what is the key distinction between 'Qada'' and 'Qadr'?
options: Qada' is destiny while Qadr is free will, with no link to Allah's knowledge
Qada' is prayer, while Qadr is fasting
Qada' refers to the Hereafter, while Qadr refers to worldly life
Qada' is the actual unfolding of events in life, while Qadr is Allah's complete, eternal preordained plan and knowledge of all things
learnings.learning: Qada' refers to the actual events that unfold in a person's life, while Qadr is Allah's complete and eternal knowledge and plan encompassing everything that will happen.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada' and Qadr

learnings.question: In Islamic teaching, what does a well-known verse in Surah Ar-Ra'd (13:11) say must happen before Allah changes the condition of a people?
options: A change in the weather or environment
A change in leadership
A change within themselves (their own inner state)
A period of divine punishment
learnings.learning: Surah Ar-Ra'd 13:11 teaches that Allah does not change the condition of a people until they change what is within themselves first.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada' and Qadr

learnings.question: When a person's sincere prayer (Dua) appears to change the outcome of their life (their Qada'), how is this reconciled with Allah's Qadr (preordained plan)?
options: It means Allah's plan was incomplete and had to be revised
It proves that Qadr does not actually exist
The change itself, and the decision to pray, were already known and included within Allah's Qadr
It means the person's fate was altered purely by chance
learnings.learning: Even when Dua appears to change a person's Qada', that change and the act of praying were always encompassed within Allah's Qadr, since His knowledge is complete.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada' and Qadr

learnings.question: A word-frequency analysis of the Quran tested whether the Pareto Principle (the 80/20 rule) applied to its vocabulary. What share of the Quran's total word count did the top 20 most frequent words actually account for?
options: About 20.83%
About 5%
About 50%
About 80%
learnings.learning: A data analysis of Quranic word frequency found the top 20 most common words made up only about 20.83% of total word count, not the 80% the Pareto Principle would predict.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: In Arabic script, what term refers to the small diacritical markings placed above or below letters to indicate vowel sounds and pronunciation?
options: Tafsir
Tashkeel
Isnad
Tajweed
learnings.learning: Tashkeel are the diacritical marks placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate vowel sounds; without them, the same spelling can be read multiple ways.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: When analyzing word frequency in the Quran, why was the original Arabic text used instead of an English translation?
options: Because no English translation of the Quran exists
Because analyzing Arabic text was computationally faster
Because Arabic words are always exactly one syllable long
Because translations aren't a direct match, and Arabic has vastly more distinct words than English (roughly a 71-to-1 ratio)
learnings.learning: The analysis used Arabic instead of English translation because English translations aren't a direct match and Arabic has an estimated 71 times more distinct words than English.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python
